:::{#hero-heading}

I am a clinical pharmacologist and physician-researcher investigating how precision pharmacotherapy and pharmacogenetics improve patient outcomes. My research program bridges prospective randomized clinical trials, nationwide Danish health registries, and clinical implementation to establish pharmacological causality and optimize drug safety.

I serve as Sponsor and Principal Investigator for the nationwide SAMSON-2 trial, establishing an N-of-1 trial platform to systematically evaluate statin-associated muscle symptoms and overcome drug intolerance. In parallel, I lead the TDM-VISION project, establishing therapeutic drug monitoring algorithms for targeted oral oncolytics in chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
